shared_elements: schematic human figure(s) rendered as simple lines/strokes
long straight lines used as ground or framing bands
carved outline figures filled or drawn in painted line on rock
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic, linear pecked figures on rock in the same conventions: stick-like humans reduced to strokes, concentric circle/disc motifs (A's large concentric sun-disc body, and disc-like elements amid B's fields), and long straight lines used as bases or dividers. The biggest difference in content is that B is dominated by repeated hulled boats with upturned prows carrying rows of crew strokes, an element wholly absent in A, whose single large dancing/disc-headed figure with splayed limbs has no counterpart in B.
